# Paper navigation

Use exact headings to locate current line numbers. Read relevant passages, not both complete documents. This index locates evidence; it does not summarize findings.

## Main paper — [paper.md](paper.md)

| Exact heading | Look here for |
| --- | --- |
| I. INTRODUCTION | Motivation and contributions (Fig. 1 is placed in the front matter before this heading) |
| II. RELATED WORK | Related work |
| III. BACKGROUND | Parent of A. PAC-NMPC and B. Actor Critic Reinforcement Learning |
| A. PAC-NMPC | Under III. BACKGROUND: PAC-NMPC background, equation (1), the probabilistic guarantee later cited as '(eq. III-A)' |
| B. Actor Critic Reinforcement Learning | Under III. BACKGROUND: actor-critic background |
| IV. APPROACH | Parent of the three method subsections |
| A. Problem Formulation | Under IV. APPROACH: problem formulation, equations (2)-(4) |
| B. Learned Value Function | Under IV. APPROACH: learned value function, equation (5) |
| C. PAC-NMPC with Learned Value Function | Under IV. APPROACH: PAC-NMPC with the learned value function, equation (6) |
| V. SIMULATION EXPERIMENTS | Parent of the four simulation subsections |
| A. Experimental Setup | Under V. SIMULATION EXPERIMENTS: simulation setup, equation (7); Figs. 2-3 are placed here |
| B. Cluttered Environments | Under V. SIMULATION EXPERIMENTS: simulation trials in cluttered environments (stochastic bicycle model); Fig. 4 |
| C. Concave Trap Environments | Under V. SIMULATION EXPERIMENTS: simulation trials in concave-trap environments; Figs. 5-6 |
| D. Fixed-wing UAV | Under V. SIMULATION EXPERIMENTS: fixed-wing UAV simulations; Figs. 7-9 |
| VI. HARDWARE EXPERIMENTS | Hardware experiments with the 1/10th-scale rally car; Fig. 10 |
| VII. DISCUSSION & CONCLUSION | Discussion and conclusion |
| REFERENCES | Bibliography, 55 entries |
| Conversion notes | Source details, authors' typos, and the bar-chart values of Figs. 2, 5, 8, 9, 10 read from the figure images |

For long sections, search a narrower subsection or prompt. Headings inside fenced quotations are source content, not document section boundaries.

## Assets

Figure and table captions in the documents link to the files below. Open only the needed image; for a table, read its header and relevant rows first.

- `assets/figure/`: main figures (JPEG).
- `assets/supp_figs/`: supplementary and extended-data figures (JPEG).
- `assets/table/`: main tables (CSV, or JPEG when transcription is unreliable).
- `assets/supp_table/`: supplementary tables (CSV, or JPEG fallback).

Asset paths are relative to the skill root. CSVs retain internal blank rows; captions and merged headers may also occupy rows. Consult the document notes before treating every row as data.
